description: This file defines the BaseDocument class within the Goteo framework. It contains methods for validating, saving, and retrieving documents, indicating it manages file upload and database persistence operations for document entities.

classes.name: BaseDocument
classes.description: A class handling document validation, storage, and retrieval operations within the Goteo framework, extending the Document class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document's attributes, checking for filename, upload errors, temporary file presence, and size.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the document to the database after uploading the file, ensuring directory structure and generating database entries.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a document record from the database by its name.
